name: Sitelets for Multisite
author: Ralph Massetti

sections.description:
Manage Your WordPress Multisite System with One Click

Don’t struggle with thousands of web pages and hundreds of subsites. With Sitelets for Multisite, you gain effortless content and branding control from a centralized dashboard. Whether your organization has 2 or 2,000 subsites, this plugin provides the end-to-end governance you need.

Main Features:

  • Control global branding and content across all sites in a Multisite network.
  • Customize content for each subsite while maintaining brand consistency.
  • Seamless integration with Elementor & Elementor Pro.
  • White-label management and multisite-specific overrides.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to retrieve news and blog posts from sitelets.com. No identifying user information is transmitted.

  • https://www.sitelets.com/terms-of-service/
  • https://www.sitelets.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Sitelets to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Why is Sitelets different from template-based website builders?

Sitelets isn’t just another website builder plugin; it’s a solution tailored for businesses that operate across multiple locations. You maintain central brand settings while each subsite (Sitelet) adapts to local needs.

How does Sitelets maintain brand consistency?

By controlling uneditable elements through a centralized admin dashboard, Sitelets ensures unified branding across all subsites.

What kind of support can I expect?

We offer 24/7 real-time live chat and email support for all license types, whether you’re a startup or a large enterprise.

Will the Sitelets plugin work with other plugins and themes?

Yes. Sitelets has been tested with leading WordPress plugins and themes for full compatibility.

What are the minimum requirements to use Sitelets?

  • WordPress Multisite activated
  • At least one subsite created
  • Elementor or Elementor Pro installed

How can I uninstall the plugin?

From the Network Admin, simply deactivate and delete the plugin.
